agentview.depth_convention: robosuite normalized depth -> get_real_depth_map metric; image flipud
agentview.name: agentview

sideview.depth_convention: robosuite normalized depth -> get_real_depth_map metric; image flipud
sideview.name: sideview

fusion_contract.dynamic_facts: p:Held/OnTable/Inside/AtBuffer from the fused public blob only

estimators.agentview: ALL_SURFACE_MEAN (identical to the validated v1 estimator)
estimators.sideview: EXTENTS_MIDPOINT_XY_MEAN_Z (midpoint of min/max world x and y of valid surface points)

fusion.none_valid: UNKNOWN (blob absent); no carry-over from any other frame or source
fusion.ratio: support/reference if reference>0 else (1.0 if support>=min_pixels else 0.0)
fusion.reference: support of the same object in the same view at the first perception call of the episode
fusion.select: valid view with the larger ratio; exact tie -> earlier camera in CAMERAS order
fusion.support: number of finite depth-valid pixels inside the object's palette mask

pair_contract.exact: per camera rgb sha256 and metric-depth sha256 equal -> EXACT
pair_contract.gpu_policy: both members of a U/V pair run sequentially on the same GPU
pair_contract.otherwise: FAIL; thresholds are not widened after seeing results
pair_contract.render_self_repeat: two direct offscreen renders of the unchanged state compared per camera, plus cached observation vs fresh render (evidence for the non-bitwise cause)
